summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing ongoing share buy-backs under a pre-announced program for employee share-based incentive schemes. The program announced 4 Feb 2026 runs 13 Feb 2026–15 Jan 2027, with total purchase amount NOK 1,971M and max 19.6M shares. On 15 May 2026, Equinor bought 533,244 shares at avg NOK 356.31, totaling ~NOK 190M. Cumulative purchases under the program are 2,046,262 shares for ~NOK 667M. Following these, Equinor holds 65,074,963 own shares (2.55% of capital). This is a routine capital return via open-market repurchases, not a tender offer. Watch for continued execution within program limits.
